findings.body: The only no-window drill rule is restricted to Actual-only answers, but the inherited period contract explicitly preserves older saved views and pins containing Actual and Budget with no period (`docs/specs/ask-period-control.md:244`; also `plans/ASK-BUDGET-PERIOD.md:101`). Those selections still rerun and produce live Actuals, while criterion 9 here promises fresh drill links on saved/pinned reruns. The spec therefore leaves their required drill range undefined and names no proof for them; a planner cannot determine whether to derive the range from Actual pins or make these targets inert, the latter contradicting the stated “every live Actual” capability. Define the no-window rule for any rerun containing Actual and add the corresponding saved/pinned mixed-measure proof.
